nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] phase-acceptance: The foot ring does not read as a ring. This is the largest difference and the reason the rating stays at 7.0. The brown torus (assets/paint-pot.ts:178, R 0.0252 m, r 0.003 m, centre y 0.003 m) lies inside the pot wall above y = 2.5 mm. It is proud of the flare only for y <= 2 mm (1.44 mm at y = 0.2 mm, 0.19 mm at y = 1 mm). The cutouts and the 4 views show a ragged brown line (0.2% of the silhouette, about 1 px at 128 px). The comment at line 177 (a bead 0.006 m tall, 1.2 mm proud of the flare) is true only at the lowest 1 mm. Rationale: the redo brief asks for a warm brown foot ring; the body exists, but no ring shows. Suggested change: move the ring outward so that 1.5 mm or more shows over 4 mm of height, and mesh it at detail 0.002 m or less.

F2 [Nit] phase-acceptance: The paint surface shows only in the 30 degree sprites. The cutouts (forge cutout, default elevation 0, src/cli/forge.ts:67) and the 4 renders (elevation 6 to 12) hide it, because the surface sits 3 mm below the rim as the brief asks. There the paint reads through the drips and the rim lips only. The front cutout shows 2 drips (0 and 50 degrees), the 200 degree drip shows only a lip, and the back view shows 1 drip. Rationale: the brief fixes this geometry, so the maker did not fail; the owner may choose a cutout elevation of 15 to 20 degrees for this prop if the fill level must read.

F3 [Nit] phase-acceptance: The drips are stiff. Each run is a bar about 11 mm wide with an even wave (assets/paint-pot.ts:125-137), the front run is half the pot height (0.040 m), and the rim lips stand 2.8 mm above the rim as round knobs (the far rim in the S sprite). They read as thick goo more than as thin paint runs. Rationale: this lowers the shape language and appeal scores to 3 to 3.5; the paint still reads. Suggested change: narrow each run near the rim and lower the lip crest to 1.5 mm or less.

F4 [Nit] phase-acceptance: The jug ear is a nub, not a handle. The half torus (assets/paint-pot.ts:162-166, R 0.0065 m) shows no hole in the side view (panel 3 of out/paint-pot/render.png), and the silhouette stays a plain cylinder. The ear comes from the original brief, not from the redo brief. Rationale: this keeps the proportion score at 3.

F5 [Nit] phase-acceptance: In the sprites N and E the glossy flat paint surface glares to a pale tint (pale pink for red, pale blue for blue, pale yellow for yellow). The preset colour is weak in 2 of 8 directions. Rationale: this follows roughness 0.3 from the brief and the sprite light; no change requested.

Rationale: a reviewer who reads only the card cannot judge the paint; the fix belongs to the owner of review-cards.py and is outside this step.

(b) It says 3,263 triangles before reduction; 3,263 is the --fast build count, and stats.json shows 10,468 raw and 2,218 final triangles. (c) The quoted mech-check line omits the files key of the real line. (d) The design note and the description string say 0.083 m tall; the bounds are 0.0843 m with the lips (the pot is 0.0798 m). Rationale: the wording is wrong and the results are right; no asset change.
